name: Texas

response.rule_text: Officer must promptly produce information (§ 552.221); if it cannot be produced within 10 business days the officer must certify that in writing and set a reasonable date (§ 552.221(d)); a body wanting to withhold must request an AG decision within 10 business days.

fees.labor_rule: For requests of 50 or fewer pages charge excludes materials, labor and overhead (§ 552.261); otherwise charges reasonably include costs of reproducing, not exceeding actual cost (§ 552.262).
fees.copy_rule: Charge reasonably includes all costs related to reproducing, not excessive and not above actual cost (§§ 552.261-.262).
fees.waiver_rule: May be waived or reduced if it primarily benefits the general public (§ 552.267).
fees.estimate_required: Written itemized statement required when charge exceeds $40; requester has 10 business days to respond (§ 552.2615).
fees.late_penalty: Treble damages for bad-faith overcharging (§ 552.269(b)); misdemeanor for criminally negligent refusal (§ 552.353).

appeal.body: District court (mandamus); Attorney General decides when a body seeks to withhold
appeal.rule_text: No administrative appeal; requester or AG may sue for mandamus in district court of the county where the body's main offices are, no special limit (four-year residual period applied by one court). Body must seek AG decision in 10 business days; AG decides within 45 working days, extendable 10; body has 30 calendar days to sue over the decision.

format_rule: Requester may choose paper or electronic if the body can produce it without new software/hardware (§ 552.228); no obligation to create new information.
notes: Read chars 0-200k and 225-325k (page 436k). Failure to timely request AG decision means information is presumed public, not deemed denial; delay as denial 'not specifically addressed'.
